mapper.sql: select w.work_order_id, w.work_order_no, w.customer_org_id, c.customer_name, w.device_id, d.device_name, d.serial_number, m.brand_id, b.brand_name, d.model_id, m.model_name, w.title, w.fault_description, w.priority, w.status, w.assignee_user_id, au.user_name as assignee_user_name, au.nick_name as assignee_nick_name, w.reporter_user_id, ru.user_name as reporter_user_name, ru.nick_name as reporter_nick_name, w.completion_time, w.close_time, w.del_flag, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, w.remark from oc_work_order w inner join oc_customer_org c on c.customer_org_id = w.customer_org_id inner join oc_device d on d.device_id = w.device_id inner join oc_product_model m on m.model_id = d.model_id inner join oc_brand b on b.brand_id = m.brand_id left join sys_user au on au.user_id = w.assignee_user_id left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = w.reporter_user_id
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, d.dept_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and (u.user_id = 1 or (r.role_key = 'oc_service' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0')) order by u.user_id

select distinct u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, d.dept_name from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and (u.user_id = 1 or (r.role_key = 'oc_service' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0')) limit 1
select count(1) from oc_work_order where del_flag = '0' and status in ('0', '1')
select count(1) from oc_work_order where device_id = #{deviceId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into oc_work_order ( work_order_no, customer_org_id, device_id, title, fault_description, priority, status, assignee_user_id, reporter_user_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{workOrderNo}, #{customerOrgId}, #{deviceId}, #{title}, #{faultDescription}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assigneeUserId}, #{reporterUserId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update oc_work_order set customer_org_id = #{customerOrgId}, device_id = #{deviceId}, title = #{title}, fault_description = #{faultDescription}, priority = #{priority}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where work_order_id = #{workOrderId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update oc_work_order set assignee_user_id = #{assigneeUserId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where work_order_id = #{workOrderId} and status != '3' and del_flag = '0'

update oc_work_order set status = #{targetStatus}, completion_time = #{completionTime}, close_time = #{closeTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where work_order_id = #{workOrderId} and status = #{currentStatus} and del_flag = '0'
